actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

official_title: A bill to provide for certain maps relating to the availability of broadband service and funding for broadband infrastructure deployment to be consolidated into a single online mapping tool, to provide for certain improvements with respect to broadband mapping data, and for other purposes.
